## ESI.ts Test Suite -- Complete Analysis

### 1. Test Directory Structure

```
tests/
  tdd/                           # Unit tests (TDD)
    access-lists/                # AccessListsClient.test.ts
    alliances/                   # AllianceClient.test.ts
    assets/                      # AssetsClient.test.ts
    calendar/                    # CalendarClient.test.ts
    characters/                  # CharacterClient.test.ts
    clients/                     # FreelanceJobsClient.test.ts
    clones/                      # ClonesClient.test.ts
    config/                      # configManager.test.ts
    contacts/                    # ContactsClient.test.ts
    contracts/                   # ContractsClient.test.ts
    core/                        # ~35 core test files
    corporations/                # CorporationsClient.test.ts
    dogma/                       # DogmaClient.test.ts
    factions/                    # FactionClient.test.ts
    fittings/                    # FittingsClient.test.ts
    fleets/                      # FleetClient.test.ts
    incursions/                  # IncursionsClient.test.ts
    industry/                    # IndustryClient.test.ts
    insurance/                   # InsuranceClient.test.ts
    killmails/                   # KillmailClient.test.ts
    location/                    # LocationClient.test.ts
    loyalty/                     # LoyaltyClient.test.ts
    mail/                        # MailClient.test.ts
    market/                      # MarketClient.test.ts, MarketClient.streaming.test.ts
    mercenary/                   # MercenaryClient.test.ts
    meta/                        # MetaClient.test.ts
    pi/                          # PiClient.test.ts
    route/                       # RouteClient.test.ts
    schemas/                     # 3 schema test files
    search/                      # searchClient.test.ts
    skills/                      # SkillsClient.test.ts
    skyhooks/                    # SkyhooksClient.test.ts
    sovereignty/                 # SovereigntyClient.test.ts
    status/                      # StatusClient.test.ts
    testing/                     # TestDataFactory.test.ts
    ui/                          # UiClient.test.ts
    universe/                    # UniverseClient.test.ts
    wallet/                      # WalletClient.test.ts
    wars/                        # WarsClient.test.ts
  bdd/
    features/
      core/                      # 38 .feature files (Gherkin)
      integration/               # integration-workflows.feature
      performance/               # performance.feature
    step-definitions/
      core/                      # 38 step definition .ts files
      integration/               # integration-workflows.steps.ts
      performance/               # performance.steps.ts
      shared/                    # common.ts (shared helpers)
    support/
      world.ts                   # TestWorld class
  integration/
    client-integration.test.ts   # Live ESI client-level integration
    esi-spec-contract.test.ts    # Contract tests against swagger spec
    full-stack.test.ts           # Full-stack integration (mocked)
    gated-auth.test.ts           # Authenticated endpoint tests
    live-esi.test.ts             # Raw HTTP live ESI tests
```

### 2. Test Tiers

The project has **five distinct test tiers**:

**Tier 1: Unit / TDD** (`npm test` / `jest --config jest.unit.config.cjs`)
- Located in `tests/tdd/`
- ~85+ test files covering every domain client and all core subsystems
- Uses `jest-fetch-mock` for HTTP mocking
- Runs via `jest.unit.config.cjs`

**Tier 2: BDD** (`npm run bdd`)
- Located in `tests/bdd/`
- 40 Gherkin `.feature` files with corresponding `.steps.ts` files
- Uses `jest-cucumber` library (`defineFeature` / `loadFeature` pattern)
- Runs via the same `jest.unit.config.cjs` with `--testPathPatterns=step-definitions`
- Each domain has its own `npm run bdd:<domain>` script (e.g., `bdd:alliance`, `bdd:market`)
- Features use the EARS (Easy Approach to Requirements Specification) notation in scenario names (Event-driven, Ubiquitous, Optional, Unwanted, State-driven)

**Tier 3: Integration (mocked)** (`npm run test:integration`)
- Located in `tests/integration/full-stack.test.ts`
- Uses `jest-fetch-mock` but tests the entire EsiClient stack (middleware, caching, circuit breaker, pagination, token refresh, DI isolation)
- Runs via `jest.integration.config.cjs` with 30-second timeout

**Tier 4: Live / Contract** (`npm run test:integration:live`)
- `tests/integration/live-esi.test.ts` -- raw `fetch()` calls to `https://esi.evetech.net/latest`
- `tests/integration/client-integration.test.ts` -- tests EsiClient against the real ESI API
- `tests/integration/esi-spec-contract.test.ts` -- fetches the live swagger spec and validates endpoint coverage, type drift, cache TTL drift, and scope drift
- Gated by `ESI_LIVE_TESTS=true` environment variable
- Uses `describeIfLive = LIVE_TESTS_ENABLED ? describe : describe.skip`

**Tier 5: Gated / Authenticated** (`npm run test:integration:gated`)
- `tests/integration/gated-auth.test.ts`
- Requires `ESI_GATED_TESTS=true` and a valid `ESI_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable
- Loads the token from a `.env` file via `node --env-file=.env`
- Extracts characterId from the JWT token payload
- Tests authenticated endpoints: Location, Skills, Wallet, Assets, Characters, Clones, Contacts, Killmails, Mail, Fittings, Industry, Market (auth), Loyalty, Contracts, Calendar, Search, Faction Warfare
- Each describe block has `afterAll(() => delay(500))` to avoid API hammering

### 3. How Validation Is Currently Tested

Validation testing occurs at three levels:

**a) Input validation** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\validation.test.ts`)
- Tests `validatePathParam` -- accepts valid IDs, rejects empty/null/undefined, path traversal chars, query string chars, NaN/Infinity
- Tests `validateQueryParam` -- accepts strings/numbers, rejects null/undefined/NaN, enforces 2000-char max length
- Tests `validateBaseUrl` -- enforces HTTPS, allowlisted hosts, rejects subdomain spoofing, supports `unsafeAllowCustomHost`

**b) Response validation integration** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\schemas\validation-integration.test.ts`)
- Tests the full request pipeline with validation enabled vs disabled
- Uses `jest-fetch-mock` with invalid response payloads
- Verifies `EsiValidationError` is thrown for type mismatches and missing required fields
- Verifies passthrough of unknown/extra fields
- Tests `EsiValidationError` properties (url, validationError, statusCode=0, name, requestId)
- Tests `isValidationError()` type guard
- Tests inheritance: `EsiValidationError instanceof EsiError`

**c) BDD validation** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\features\core\runtime-validation.feature` + step definitions)
- 9 BDD scenarios covering valid/invalid responses, extra fields, disabled validation, error catchability, missing required fields, optional fields, nested objects, and enum validation

### 4. How Schema Tests Work

Schema tests are in `tests/tdd/schemas/` and use **Zod schemas** (`zod` v4.4.3 dependency):

**`schema-validation.test.ts`** (D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\schemas\schema-validation.test.ts)
- Tests Zod schemas imported from `src/schemas/` (character, alliance, market, universe)
- Uses `safeParse()` for validation with success/failure checking
- Test categories:
  - **Valid data parsing** -- Verifies correct parse of fully valid objects
  - **Invalid data rejection (type mismatches)** -- string-for-number, number-for-string, string-for-boolean, etc.
  - **Missing required fields** -- Each required field tested individually
  - **Optional fields can be omitted** -- Confirms optional fields parse as undefined
  - **Passthrough mode preserves extra fields** -- Schemas use `.passthrough()` to keep unknown fields
  - **Round-trip idempotency** -- Parsing output twice produces identical results
  - **String enum validation** -- Valid/invalid enum values (gender, state, contact_type, sender_type, from_type)
  - **Nullable fields accept null values** -- Optional arrays, is_deleted, etc.
  - **Nested object validation** -- Medal graphics, SolarSystem planets, Constellation position, TypeInfo dogma
  - **Array element type validation** -- Number arrays reject strings, etc.

**`common-schemas.test.ts`** (D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\schemas\common-schemas.test.ts)
- Tests `RateLimitMetaSchema`, `EsiResponseMetaSchema`, and `esiResponse()` helper
- Validates cache hit type enum (`spec-ttl`, `etag-304`, `stale-on-error`)
- Tests the `esiResponse(dataSchema)` composite factory (wraps data+meta)

### 5. Fixtures / Mocks

**No fixture files on disk** -- The project uses inline mock data and factory patterns instead.

**`TestDataFactory`** (D:\code\ESI.ts\src\testing\TestDataFactory.ts)
- Central factory class with static methods for creating typed test objects with defaults + overrides
- Factory methods for: AllianceInfo, AllianceContact, AllianceContactLabel, CharacterInfo, CharacterPortrait, CharacterAttributes, CharacterSkill, CharacterRoles, CorporationHistoryEntry, CharacterMedal, CharacterNotification, MarketPrice, MarketHistory, CharacterMarketOrder, SolarSystem, Station, Structure, ItemType, ItemGroup, Star, Planet, SearchResults, EntityName, CorporationInfo, CorporationMemberRoles, CorporationAsset, CorporationStructure, CorporationWallet, WalletJournalEntry, FleetInfo, FleetMember, FleetWing, IndustryJob, Blueprint, CharacterAsset, CharacterLocation, CharacterSkills, MarketOrder, WalletTransaction, Contract, SovereigntySystem, SovereigntyHub, OrbitalSkyhook, RaidableSkyhook, MercenaryDen, MercenaryTacticalOperation, AccessListEntry
- `createTestScenarios()` -- returns sets of alliances, characters, corporations, error scenarios
- `createPerformanceTestData(size)` -- generates small/medium/large datasets with relationships
- `createRealisticTestData()` -- creates inter-related entities with relationship metadata
- `createError(statusCode)` -- factory for EsiError instances

**`jest-fetch-mock`** (devDependency) -- All unit/BDD tests mock HTTP via `fetchMock.enableMocks()` + `fetchMock.mockResponseOnce()`

**`getBody()`** (D:\code\ESI.ts\src\core\util\testHelpers.ts) -- trivial helper that unwraps `apiCall()` promise (used as `getBody(() => client.method(...))`)

**BDD shared helpers** (D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\step-definitions\shared\common.ts) -- re-exports `EsiClient`, `EsiError`, `TestDataFactory`, and a `expectEsiError()` helper

**BDD TestWorld** (D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\support\world.ts) -- wraps an `EsiClient` with `result`, `error`, `results[]` state for step definitions

### 6. Pagination Tests

Pagination is tested comprehensively across multiple files:

**Page-based pagination** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\PaginationHandler.test.ts`)
- Tests `PaginationHandler.fetchRemainingPages()` static method
- Single page (no extra fetches), 2-page, multi-page scenarios
- Query param preservation during pagination (e.g., `?order_type=all&page=2`)
- `stopOnEmptyPage` option, `maxPages` option
- Auth header inclusion for authenticated endpoints
- Retry on page failures (with `maxRetries` and `retryDelayMs`)
- Consecutive failure threshold stops further fetching
- Non-array JSON wrapping, POST body forwarding

**Cursor-based pagination** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\CursorPaginationHandler.test.ts`)
- Tests `CursorPaginationHandler.fetchPage()` and `fetchAll()`
- Cursor extraction from `x-cursor-before` / `x-cursor-after` headers
- Query param preservation, auth headers, URL encoding of cursor tokens
- Stops on null `after` cursor or empty response
- `maxPages` option, retry with exponential backoff
- Duplicate handling across pages (preserved, not deduped)
- `extractCursors()` static method tests

**Pagination integration** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\PaginationIntegration.test.ts`)
- Tests pagination through `handleRequest()` (the actual request handler)
- Verifies page 1 is NOT fetched twice
- Query param preservation, graceful degradation on page failure
- Missing `x-pages` header defaults to 1 page

**Async pagination iterator** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\AsyncPaginationIterator.test.ts`)

**Full-stack pagination** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\full-stack.test.ts` -- "Pagination Assembly" section)

### 7. Cache-Related Tests

**ETagCacheManager unit tests** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\ETagCacheManager.test.ts`)
- Basic CRUD: set/get/has/getETag/delete/clear
- TTL and expiration (with `setTimeout` waits)
- Cache size management (LRU eviction on max entries)
- Manual cleanup of expired entries
- Cache statistics (hits, misses, hitRate, oldest/newest entry)
- `deleteByPath()` pattern matching
- Configuration updates at runtime

**Spec-aware caching** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\SpecAwareCaching.test.ts`)
- Tests the spec-aware cache bypass: when a request is within the ESI spec's `x-cached-seconds` TTL, it returns cached data without any HTTP call
- Verifies GET-only behavior (POST requests always hit the wire)
- Tests path normalization from camelCase to snake_case for TTL lookup
- Cache miss scenarios when cache is empty or no TTL configured

**ETag integration** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\ETagIntegration.test.ts`)
- Tests the full ETag flow via `EsiClient`: first request caches, second returns from cache
- 304 Not Modified behavior
- Cache management operations (stats, clear, config updates)
- ETag disabled mode
- Error handling (304 without cache entry, network errors)

**BDD ETag caching** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\step-definitions\core\etag-caching.steps.ts`)
- 9 BDD scenarios matching the etag-caching.feature, testing first-time caching, 304 returns, cache updates, statistics, clearing, runtime config, stale-on-error fallback, missing ETags, disabled caching

**Full-stack integration ETag round-trip** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\full-stack.test.ts` -- "ETag Cache Round-Trip" section)
- Tests cache population with mock responses, If-None-Match on second request, stale cache on 5xx errors

### 8. Live / Contract Tests

**Raw live tests** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\live-esi.test.ts`)
- Direct `fetch()` calls to ESI API -- no client library code used
- Tests: Server Status, Market Prices, Universe Types (pagination headers), Rate Limit Headers, Alliances, Incursions, Insurance, Sovereignty (campaigns/map/structures), Industry (systems/facilities), Universe (types/systems/regions/constellations/stations/groups/races/bloodlines/ancestries/factions/graphics/categories), Dogma (attributes/effects), Wars, Market (history/groups/orders/types), Route (Jita to Amarr), Faction Warfare (stats/wars/systems/leaderboards), Killmails
- All gated by `ESI_LIVE_TESTS=true`

**Client-level integration** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\client-integration.test.ts`)
- Tests EsiClient methods against live ESI
- Covers: Status, Market Prices, Alliance Info, Universe Type, ETag Cache Round-Trip, Rate Limit Tracking, Pagination Assembly (>1000 entries), Error Handling (404), Route Calculation, Diagnostics
- Also gated by `ESI_LIVE_TESTS=true`

**Contract / spec drift** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\esi-spec-contract.test.ts`)
- Fetches live swagger spec from `https://esi.evetech.net/latest/swagger.json`
- **Endpoint Coverage**: parses local endpoint definition files and the swagger spec, detects phantom endpoints, method mismatches, and uncovered spec endpoints
- **Type Drift Detection**: parses hand-written TypeScript interfaces and generated types, detects missing fields and optionality mismatches
- **Cache TTL Drift**: compares `esi-cache-ttls.generated.ts` against swagger `x-cached-seconds` -- this one **fails** on mismatch (not just warning)
- **Scope Drift**: compares `esi-scopes.generated.ts` against swagger security requirements -- also **fails** on mismatch

**Gated auth tests** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\gated-auth.test.ts`)
- Requires real ESI token; described in detail in section 2 above

### 9. Coverage Configuration

Defined in `D:\code\ESI.ts\jest.unit.config.cjs`:

```javascript
coverageDirectory: 'coverage/unit',
coverageReporters: ['text', 'lcov'],
collectCoverageFrom: [
  'src/**/*.ts',
  '!src/**/*.d.ts',
  '!src/types/**/*.ts',
],
coverageThreshold: {
  global: {
    branches: 80,
    functions: 75,
    lines: 90,
    statements: 90,
  },
},
```

- Coverage runs via `npm run coverage` (= `jest --config jest.unit.config.cjs --coverage`)
- Output to `coverage/unit/` in text and lcov formats
- Excludes `.d.ts` files and `src/types/` directory
- Thresholds: 90% lines/statements, 80% branches, 75% functions
- Integration tests (`jest.integration.config.cjs`) do NOT have coverage configuration
- Also has `jest-junit` installed as a devDependency (for CI reporting)

### 10. Test Helpers and Utilities

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\config\jest\jest.setup.ts` | Global test setup: enables `jest-fetch-mock`, creates a shared `ApiClient` via `ApiClientBuilder`, sets `RateLimiter` to test mode, resets mocks + rate limiter in `beforeEach`, exports `getClient()` |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\config\jest\globalSetup.ts` | Minimal -- logs "Jest Unit Config Loaded" |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\config\jest\globalTeardown.ts` | Minimal -- logs "Rate limiter reset after test completion" |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\core\util\testHelpers.ts` | Exports `getBody()` -- trivially wraps `apiCall()` to extract the response body |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\testing\TestDataFactory.ts` | Factory class with 40+ static factory methods for domain test objects (see section 5) |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\support\world.ts` | `TestWorld` class wrapping `EsiClient` + `result`/`error`/`results` state |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\step-definitions\shared\common.ts` | Re-exports `EsiClient`, `EsiError`, `TestDataFactory`, and `expectEsiError()` helper |

**Key patterns across all test files:**
- Almost every unit test file starts with `fetchMock.enableMocks()` and resets mocks in `beforeEach`
- Domain client tests use `ApiClientBuilder` to construct the `ApiClient`, then instantiate the domain client
- RateLimiter is always set to test mode (`rateLimiter.setTestMode(true)`) to avoid real rate limiting delays
- Integration tests with mocked HTTP use a `standardHeaders()` helper that returns typical ESI response headers
- Live tests use `describeIfLive` / `describeIfGated` conditional describe blocks gated by environment variables
- Live tests include `delay()` calls between test groups to avoid hitting ESI rate limits

### 2. Test Tiers

The project has **five distinct test tiers**:

**Tier 1: Unit / TDD** (`npm test` / `jest --config jest.unit.config.cjs`)
- Located in `tests/tdd/`
- ~85+ test files covering every domain client and all core subsystems
- Uses `jest-fetch-mock` for HTTP mocking
- Runs via `jest.unit.config.cjs`

**Tier 2: BDD** (`npm run bdd`)
- Located in `tests/bdd/`
- 40 Gherkin `.feature` files with corresponding `.steps.ts` files
- Uses `jest-cucumber` library (`defineFeature` / `loadFeature` pattern)
- Runs via the same `jest.unit.config.cjs` with `--testPathPatterns=step-definitions`
- Each domain has its own `npm run bdd:<domain>` script (e.g., `bdd:alliance`, `bdd:market`)
- Features use the EARS (Easy Approach to Requirements Specification) notation in scenario names (Event-driven, Ubiquitous, Optional, Unwanted, State-driven)

**Tier 3: Integration (mocked)** (`npm run test:integration`)
- Located in `tests/integration/full-stack.test.ts`
- Uses `jest-fetch-mock` but tests the entire EsiClient stack (middleware, caching, circuit breaker, pagination, token refresh, DI isolation)
- Runs via `jest.integration.config.cjs` with 30-second timeout

**Tier 4: Live / Contract** (`npm run test:integration:live`)
- `tests/integration/live-esi.test.ts` -- raw `fetch()` calls to `https://esi.evetech.net/latest`
- `tests/integration/client-integration.test.ts` -- tests EsiClient against the real ESI API
- `tests/integration/esi-spec-contract.test.ts` -- fetches the live swagger spec and validates endpoint coverage, type drift, cache TTL drift, and scope drift
- Gated by `ESI_LIVE_TESTS=true` environment variable
- Uses `describeIfLive = LIVE_TESTS_ENABLED ? describe : describe.skip`

**Tier 5: Gated / Authenticated** (`npm run test:integration:gated`)
- `tests/integration/gated-auth.test.ts`
- Requires `ESI_GATED_TESTS=true` and a valid `ESI_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable
- Loads the token from a `.env` file via `node --env-file=.env`
- Extracts characterId from the JWT token payload
- Tests authenticated endpoints: Location, Skills, Wallet, Assets, Characters, Clones, Contacts, Killmails, Mail, Fittings, Industry, Market (auth), Loyalty, Contracts, Calendar, Search, Faction Warfare
- Each describe block has `afterAll(() => delay(500))` to avoid API hammering

### 3. How Validation Is Currently Tested

Validation testing occurs at three levels:

**a) Input validation** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\validation.test.ts`)
- Tests `validatePathParam` -- accepts valid IDs, rejects empty/null/undefined, path traversal chars, query string chars, NaN/Infinity
- Tests `validateQueryParam` -- accepts strings/numbers, rejects null/undefined/NaN, enforces 2000-char max length
- Tests `validateBaseUrl` -- enforces HTTPS, allowlisted hosts, rejects subdomain spoofing, supports `unsafeAllowCustomHost`

**b) Response validation integration** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\schemas\validation-integration.test.ts`)
- Tests the full request pipeline with validation enabled vs disabled
- Uses `jest-fetch-mock` with invalid response payloads
- Verifies `EsiValidationError` is thrown for type mismatches and missing required fields
- Verifies passthrough of unknown/extra fields
- Tests `EsiValidationError` properties (url, validationError, statusCode=0, name, requestId)
- Tests `isValidationError()` type guard
- Tests inheritance: `EsiValidationError instanceof EsiError`

**c) BDD validation** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\features\core\runtime-validation.feature` + step definitions)
- 9 BDD scenarios covering valid/invalid responses, extra fields, disabled validation, error catchability, missing required fields, optional fields, nested objects, and enum validation

### 4. How Schema Tests Work

Schema tests are in `tests/tdd/schemas/` and use **Zod schemas** (`zod` v4.4.3 dependency):

**`schema-validation.test.ts`** (D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\schemas\schema-validation.test.ts)
- Tests Zod schemas imported from `src/schemas/` (character, alliance, market, universe)
- Uses `safeParse()` for validation with success/failure checking
- Test categories:
  - **Valid data parsing** -- Verifies correct parse of fully valid objects
  - **Invalid data rejection (type mismatches)** -- string-for-number, number-for-string, string-for-boolean, etc.
  - **Missing required fields** -- Each required field tested individually
  - **Optional fields can be omitted** -- Confirms optional fields parse as undefined
  - **Passthrough mode preserves extra fields** -- Schemas use `.passthrough()` to keep unknown fields
  - **Round-trip idempotency** -- Parsing output twice produces identical results
  - **String enum validation** -- Valid/invalid enum values (gender, state, contact_type, sender_type, from_type)
  - **Nullable fields accept null values** -- Optional arrays, is_deleted, etc.
  - **Nested object validation** -- Medal graphics, SolarSystem planets, Constellation position, TypeInfo dogma
  - **Array element type validation** -- Number arrays reject strings, etc.

**`common-schemas.test.ts`** (D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\schemas\common-schemas.test.ts)
- Tests `RateLimitMetaSchema`, `EsiResponseMetaSchema`, and `esiResponse()` helper
- Validates cache hit type enum (`spec-ttl`, `etag-304`, `stale-on-error`)
- Tests the `esiResponse(dataSchema)` composite factory (wraps data+meta)

**`jest-fetch-mock`** (devDependency) -- All unit/BDD tests mock HTTP via `fetchMock.enableMocks()` + `fetchMock.mockResponseOnce()`

**BDD TestWorld** (D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\support\world.ts) -- wraps an `EsiClient` with `result`, `error`, `results[]` state for step definitions

### 6. Pagination Tests

Pagination is tested comprehensively across multiple files:

**Page-based pagination** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\PaginationHandler.test.ts`)
- Tests `PaginationHandler.fetchRemainingPages()` static method
- Single page (no extra fetches), 2-page, multi-page scenarios
- Query param preservation during pagination (e.g., `?order_type=all&page=2`)
- `stopOnEmptyPage` option, `maxPages` option
- Auth header inclusion for authenticated endpoints
- Retry on page failures (with `maxRetries` and `retryDelayMs`)
- Consecutive failure threshold stops further fetching
- Non-array JSON wrapping, POST body forwarding

**Cursor-based pagination** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\CursorPaginationHandler.test.ts`)
- Tests `CursorPaginationHandler.fetchPage()` and `fetchAll()`
- Cursor extraction from `x-cursor-before` / `x-cursor-after` headers
- Query param preservation, auth headers, URL encoding of cursor tokens
- Stops on null `after` cursor or empty response
- `maxPages` option, retry with exponential backoff
- Duplicate handling across pages (preserved, not deduped)
- `extractCursors()` static method tests

**Pagination integration** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\PaginationIntegration.test.ts`)
- Tests pagination through `handleRequest()` (the actual request handler)
- Verifies page 1 is NOT fetched twice
- Query param preservation, graceful degradation on page failure
- Missing `x-pages` header defaults to 1 page

**Async pagination iterator** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\AsyncPaginationIterator.test.ts`)

**Full-stack pagination** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\full-stack.test.ts` -- "Pagination Assembly" section)

### 7. Cache-Related Tests

**ETagCacheManager unit tests** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\ETagCacheManager.test.ts`)
- Basic CRUD: set/get/has/getETag/delete/clear
- TTL and expiration (with `setTimeout` waits)
- Cache size management (LRU eviction on max entries)
- Manual cleanup of expired entries
- Cache statistics (hits, misses, hitRate, oldest/newest entry)
- `deleteByPath()` pattern matching
- Configuration updates at runtime

**Spec-aware caching** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\SpecAwareCaching.test.ts`)
- Tests the spec-aware cache bypass: when a request is within the ESI spec's `x-cached-seconds` TTL, it returns cached data without any HTTP call
- Verifies GET-only behavior (POST requests always hit the wire)
- Tests path normalization from camelCase to snake_case for TTL lookup
- Cache miss scenarios when cache is empty or no TTL configured

**ETag integration** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\tdd\core\ETagIntegration.test.ts`)
- Tests the full ETag flow via `EsiClient`: first request caches, second returns from cache
- 304 Not Modified behavior
- Cache management operations (stats, clear, config updates)
- ETag disabled mode
- Error handling (304 without cache entry, network errors)

**BDD ETag caching** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\step-definitions\core\etag-caching.steps.ts`)
- 9 BDD scenarios matching the etag-caching.feature, testing first-time caching, 304 returns, cache updates, statistics, clearing, runtime config, stale-on-error fallback, missing ETags, disabled caching

**Full-stack integration ETag round-trip** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\full-stack.test.ts` -- "ETag Cache Round-Trip" section)
- Tests cache population with mock responses, If-None-Match on second request, stale cache on 5xx errors

### 8. Live / Contract Tests

**Raw live tests** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\live-esi.test.ts`)
- Direct `fetch()` calls to ESI API -- no client library code used
- Tests: Server Status, Market Prices, Universe Types (pagination headers), Rate Limit Headers, Alliances, Incursions, Insurance, Sovereignty (campaigns/map/structures), Industry (systems/facilities), Universe (types/systems/regions/constellations/stations/groups/races/bloodlines/ancestries/factions/graphics/categories), Dogma (attributes/effects), Wars, Market (history/groups/orders/types), Route (Jita to Amarr), Faction Warfare (stats/wars/systems/leaderboards), Killmails
- All gated by `ESI_LIVE_TESTS=true`

**Client-level integration** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\client-integration.test.ts`)
- Tests EsiClient methods against live ESI
- Covers: Status, Market Prices, Alliance Info, Universe Type, ETag Cache Round-Trip, Rate Limit Tracking, Pagination Assembly (>1000 entries), Error Handling (404), Route Calculation, Diagnostics
- Also gated by `ESI_LIVE_TESTS=true`

**Contract / spec drift** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\esi-spec-contract.test.ts`)
- Fetches live swagger spec from `https://esi.evetech.net/latest/swagger.json`
- **Endpoint Coverage**: parses local endpoint definition files and the swagger spec, detects phantom endpoints, method mismatches, and uncovered spec endpoints
- **Type Drift Detection**: parses hand-written TypeScript interfaces and generated types, detects missing fields and optionality mismatches
- **Cache TTL Drift**: compares `esi-cache-ttls.generated.ts` against swagger `x-cached-seconds` -- this one **fails** on mismatch (not just warning)
- **Scope Drift**: compares `esi-scopes.generated.ts` against swagger security requirements -- also **fails** on mismatch

**Gated auth tests** (`D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\integration\gated-auth.test.ts`)
- Requires real ESI token; described in detail in section 2 above

### 9. Coverage Configuration

Defined in `D:\code\ESI.ts\jest.unit.config.cjs`:

```javascript
coverageDirectory: 'coverage/unit',
coverageReporters: ['text', 'lcov'],
collectCoverageFrom: [
  'src/**/*.ts',
  '!src/**/*.d.ts',
  '!src/types/**/*.ts',
],
coverageThreshold: {
  global: {
    branches: 80,
    functions: 75,
    lines: 90,
    statements: 90,
  },
},
```

- Coverage runs via `npm run coverage` (= `jest --config jest.unit.config.cjs --coverage`)
- Output to `coverage/unit/` in text and lcov formats
- Excludes `.d.ts` files and `src/types/` directory
- Thresholds: 90% lines/statements, 80% branches, 75% functions
- Integration tests (`jest.integration.config.cjs`) do NOT have coverage configuration
- Also has `jest-junit` installed as a devDependency (for CI reporting)

### 10. Test Helpers and Utilities

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\config\jest\jest.setup.ts` | Global test setup: enables `jest-fetch-mock`, creates a shared `ApiClient` via `ApiClientBuilder`, sets `RateLimiter` to test mode, resets mocks + rate limiter in `beforeEach`, exports `getClient()` |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\config\jest\globalSetup.ts` | Minimal -- logs "Jest Unit Config Loaded" |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\config\jest\globalTeardown.ts` | Minimal -- logs "Rate limiter reset after test completion" |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\core\util\testHelpers.ts` | Exports `getBody()` -- trivially wraps `apiCall()` to extract the response body |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\src\testing\TestDataFactory.ts` | Factory class with 40+ static factory methods for domain test objects (see section 5) |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\support\world.ts` | `TestWorld` class wrapping `EsiClient` + `result`/`error`/`results` state |
| `D:\code\ESI.ts\tests\bdd\step-definitions\shared\common.ts` | Re-exports `EsiClient`, `EsiError`, `TestDataFactory`, and `expectEsiError()` helper |

**Key patterns across all test files:**
- Almost every unit test file starts with `fetchMock.enableMocks()` and resets mocks in `beforeEach`
- Domain client tests use `ApiClientBuilder` to construct the `ApiClient`, then instantiate the domain client
- RateLimiter is always set to test mode (`rateLimiter.setTestMode(true)`) to avoid real rate limiting delays
- Integration tests with mocked HTTP use a `standardHeaders()` helper that returns typical ESI response headers
- Live tests use `describeIfLive` / `describeIfGated` conditional describe blocks gated by environment variables
- Live tests include `delay()` calls between test groups to avoid hitting ESI rate limits
